rationale: The agent weakened the gold's universal theorems (always-permits, the vulnerability under the precondition, functional–imperative equivalence and main correctness) so each holds only at single concrete inputs, and it dropped the mismatch requirement from the exploit witness. The only gold guarantee it still recovers is the exploit witness, because instantiating pre_dependent_vuln_thm at the mismatched pair (0, 99) gives it back.
